title: Detailed telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tripod legs -->
  <polygon points="44,88 46,88 54,58 52,58" fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <polygon points="56,88 58,88 48,58 46,58" fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <polygon points="50,90 52,90 51,58 49,58" fill='#A0704A'/>
  <!-- tripod feet -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="89" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill='#6B4226'/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="89" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill='#6B4226'/>
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="91" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill='#6B4226'/>
  <!-- tripod hub -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="4" fill='#A0704A'/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="2" fill='#C49060'/>
  <!-- main tube -->
  <rect x="28" y="30" width="44" height="14" rx="4" fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <!-- tube highlight -->
  <rect x="30" y="32" width="40" height="4" rx="2" fill='#7AB8F0'/>
  <!-- tube rings -->
  <rect x="38" y="29" width="4" height="16" rx="1" fill='#2C6AA0'/>
  <rect x="58" y="29" width="4" height="16" rx="1" fill='#2C6AA0'/>
  <!-- front objective lens housing -->
  <rect x="22" y="27" width="10" height="20" rx="3" fill='#3A7BC0'/>
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="37" rx="4" ry="9" fill='#89C4F4'/>
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="37" rx="2.5" ry="6" fill='#C5E4FF'/>
  <!-- rear eyepiece -->
  <rect x="70" y="31" width="8" height="12" rx="2" fill='#2C6AA0'/>
  <rect x="76" y="33" width="6" height="8" rx="2" fill='#1A4A75'/>
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="37" rx="2" ry="4" fill='#89C4F4'/>
  <!-- finder scope on top -->
  <rect x="40" y="22" width="16" height="6" rx="2" fill='#E8683C'/>
  <rect x="40" y="22" width="16" height="2" rx="1" fill='#F4A07A'/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="25" r="3" fill='#C44A20'/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="25" r="1.5" fill='#F4A07A'/>
  <rect x="54" y="23" width="5" height="4" rx="1" fill='#C44A20'/>
  <!-- finder scope mount -->
  <rect x="46" y="27" width="3" height="3" fill='#2C6AA0'/>
  <!-- focus knob -->
  <circle cx="65" cy="44" r="3" fill='#E8B030'/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="44" r="1.5" fill='#F8D870'/>
  <!-- counterweight rod -->
  <rect x="58" y="44" width="2" height="8" fill='#A0704A'/>
  <!-- counterweight -->
  <circle cx="59" cy="54" r="3.5" fill='#6B4226'/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="54" r="2" fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- decorative star on tube -->
  <polygon points="50,34 51,36.5 53.5,36.5 51.5,38 52.5,40.5 50,39 47.5,40.5 48.5,38 46.5,36.5 49,36.5" fill='#F8D870'/>
</svg>
